title: Śrī Tulasī-parikramā Gīti
author: Braj Bhāṣā composition by Śrīla Chandraśekhara Kavi

translation: O Tulasī Mahārāṇī, O Vṛnda Devī, I offer my obeisances unto you again and again.

text: namo re namo re mā̐iyā namo nārāyaṇī
translation: O Nārāyaṇi I offer you my obeisances again and again.
By seeing or touching you, all sins are destroyed. Your glories are sung in the Vedas and Purāṇas.
Your leaves and soft mañjarīs are entwined at the lotus feet of Lord Nārāyaṇa. O Tulasī, by your performance of austerity you have become the worshipful consort of Śrī Śālagrām-śilā.

text: vinā tulasī prabhu eka nāhi māni
translation: You shower your mercy upon anyone who offers you incense, lamp, foodstuffs, worship and flowers. The Lord does not accept even one of fifty-six food offerings or thirty-six curries offered without Tulasī leaves.

Lord Śiva, Śukadeva Goswāmī, Nārada Muni, all the demigods headed by Lord Brahmā, the mystics, and great munis are all circumambulating you, O Tulasī Mahārāṇī. Thus Chandraśekhara sings of your glories. Please bestow upon him the gift of devotion.
